report: R3 prompt origin (ARC4 17.5, 17.9; E-84, E-27; T-3694 B-25)
about: What the main lease does with each origin report from an adapter whose harness the operator switched to origin reporting. Run against every adapter (TermLink: crates/termlink-session main_lease e84 test; AEF: B-29, P-44). 'state' is the lease as the claiming session sees it; 'held-by-other-silent' means the holder's last human prompt is older than the quiet period (5 min). 'expect' is one of: ignored (recorded ignored: origin, nothing changes), unchanged (answered, nothing changes, nothing recorded), provisional, renewed, acquired, fast-takeover.
negative_controls: an adapter that reports a doorbell or watchdog line as origin human fails case doorbell-line-is-automated (its claim would renew or take main)
an adapter that reports tool activity as a prompt fails case tool-activity-never-renews
